walkthroughs.body_html:
Paper 1: Personal Portfolio — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Paper 1: Personal Portfolio brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Paper 1: Personal Portfolio.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

Smudging

Lines

Squares

mcqs.q: What can line in a composition imply, even without representing an object?

Movement, direction, emotion, and visual rhythm.
Photographic accuracy.
